epics.title: platform: M0 Foundations
goals: One `kitchen` Python project at the repo root (single pyproject.toml, uv, extras pi/ml/server) with CI for lint, tests, contracts and ownership
kitchen/shared/models.py generated from contracts/schemas, with a CI drift check
kitchen/shared/interfaces.py: every Protocol in contracts/apis.md, the *Unavailable exceptions, Clock/FixedClock, Settings base
InMemoryStateClient with failure injection, and a scenario loader that loads every golden scenario
Fakes for partner parts (FakeEntityStore, FakeProvenanceGraph, ScriptedClassifier) and contract test suites the partner's real code must also pass
TypeScript types generated from the schemas for web/
CI lane checks: partner-owned paths, cross-team and contract-change labels; .claude/agents kept in sync with AGENTS.md

epics.title: platform: M1 Vertical Slice
goals: tests/e2e harness on fakes: typed note -> FakeJev -> answered questions -> ticket -> scenario events -> FakeProvenanceGraph -> verdict -> ConsoleGate and ConsoleSpeaker
Every golden scenario runs through the verdict policy in CI on every PR touching kitchen/verdict, contracts or tests/e2e
When the partner's parts exist: their real StateClient, EntityStore, ProvenanceGraph and LSTM classifier pass the same contract suites and the same e2e run (needs-partner)

epics.title: platform: M2 Live on Pi
goals: Deterministic replay check: the same recorded frame and event JSONL produces identical verdicts on every run
One-command stack start for laptop and Pi (the Pi half is hardware, verified by the owner)

epics.title: platform: M3 Models
goals: CI plumbing that posts model evaluations (Laya vs exact reachability, partner's LSTM vs zone rules) as artifacts
Checker that every model artifact carries a data-manifest.json

epics.title: platform: M4 Demo Hardening
goals: Failure-drill harness in tests/e2e: kill each component, assert HOLD or fault, never PASS
Offline-mode check: the stack runs with no network after setup

tasks.title: platform: kitchen Python project and CI for lint and tests
tasks.goal: Make the repo one installable `kitchen` package with a CI that lints and tests every folder, so any team can start writing code in its folder on day one.
acceptance: Root pyproject.toml defines package `kitchen` (Python >= 3.11) managed by uv, with optional extras `pi`, `ml` and `server`; `uv sync` succeeds on a clean checkout (paste output)
ruff configured at the root; `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` pass on main
Pytest markers `safety`, `hardware`, `slow` and `contract` registered at the root; the PR job deselects `hardware` and `slow`
.github/workflows/ci.yml gains a lint job and a test job (`uv run pytest -m 'not hardware and not slow'`) next to the existing contracts-and-ownership job, using astral-sh/setup-uv with caching
Test job is path-aware or fast enough that a one-folder change finishes in under 5 minutes (show the run time)
Proven on the PR: link a CI run that fails on a deliberately broken test commit and passes after reverting it
out_of_scope: Writing any folder's code or tests beyond a single smoke test
TypeScript CI (platform-07)
Golden-scenario CI (platform-08)

tasks.title: platform: generate Pydantic models into kitchen/shared/models.py
tasks.goal: Every folder imports one generated set of models that matches contracts/schemas exactly, so nobody hand-writes contract shapes.
acceptance: `uv run python tools/gen_models.py` regenerates kitchen/shared/models.py from contracts/schemas/*.schema.json, with the GENERATED header kept
Models use extra='forbid'; `uv run pytest kitchen/shared -k fixtures` parses and round-trips every file in contracts/fixtures/valid/<schema>/
Every file in contracts/fixtures/invalid/ is rejected by its model, including has-allergen-field.json (test marked safety, invariant 6)
Table dataclasses Zone, PlateBinding, ChefConfirmation and ChangeEvent from contracts/state-tables.md are generated or written alongside, with tests
CI drift check: regenerating on a clean checkout produces no git diff, otherwise the job fails
The PR records the generator used and whether cross-file $ref and the verdict if/then rules are handled; any rule it can't express gets a hand-written validator with a test
out_of_scope: TypeScript types (platform-07)
Changing any schema (that is an RFC)
Protocols and fakes (platform-03, platform-04, platform-06)

tasks.title: platform: Protocols in kitchen/shared/interfaces.py and Clock
tasks.goal: Publish every interface in contracts/apis.md as typing.Protocol classes, plus a Clock and a Settings base, so teams code against stable signatures and replays are deterministic.
acceptance: kitchen/shared/interfaces.py exposes StateClient, EntityStore, ProvenanceGraph, InteractionClassifier, JevClient, LayaClient, Transcriber, Speaker, GateDriver and Clock with the exact signatures in contracts/apis.md, typed with kitchen.shared.models
Exceptions StateUnavailable, GraphUnavailable, JevUnavailable and LayaUnavailable are exported
kitchen/shared/clock.py has SystemClock and FixedClock (advance/set); a test shows FixedClock drives t_ms deterministically
kitchen/shared/config.py has a Settings base: per-folder env prefix, secrets from env only, a clear error on a missing secret; test included
A test parses the method names out of contracts/apis.md and asserts each Protocol matches, so drift is caught
`uv run pyright kitchen/shared` passes in basic mode
out_of_scope: Any implementation other than SystemClock and FixedClock
Adding methods not in contracts/apis.md (raise an RFC instead)

tasks.title: platform: InMemoryStateClient and scenario loader
tasks.goal: Ship the stand-in for the partner's database client and a loader for scenario files, so every Python team builds and tests with no database.
acceptance: kitchen/shared/fakes has InMemoryStateClient implementing every StateClient method, including subscribe() delivering ChangeEvents on insert and update
Failure injection: set_unavailable(True) and fail_next(n) make methods raise StateUnavailable (test)
upsert_entities never deletes and never changes first_seen_t_ms or origin (test marked safety, invariant 8); amendments keep every prior ticket revision (test, invariant 9)
list_interactions returns events ordered by t_start_ms; a duplicate event_id is a no-op (test)
load_scenario(path) populates bins, late entities, tickets, plate bindings and events; every file in contracts/scenarios/ loads (`uv run pytest kitchen/shared -k scenario`)
Scenario iteration yields events, amendments and plates-at-pass in time order
out_of_scope: The partner's real StateClient or SpacetimeDB module
Computing reachability or verdicts

tasks.title: platform: end-to-end harness on fakes in tests/e2e
tasks.goal: Prove the pieces fit: run each golden scenario and a typed-note ticket through orders, the database fake, the graph fake, the verdict policy and the gate fakes, and compare against the known answers.
acceptance: `uv run pytest tests/e2e` runs every file in contracts/scenarios/ on InMemoryStateClient + FakeProvenanceGraph in rules_only mode and fails on any mismatch with `expected` (decision, allergens reached, reason codes, chain event IDs)

A typed note ("peanut allergy, traces matter") goes through FakeJev, scripted answers to every question, and send; sending with an unanswered question is refused (invariant 3); the stored ticket validates against ticket.schema.json
Verdicts drive ConsoleGate and ConsoleSpeaker if outputs has shipped them; otherwise the harness prints the verdict and notes the missing fake
The harness imports only kitchen.shared interfaces and each folder's public entry point, never team internals
`--state real` and `--graph real` flags exist and select the partner's implementations when importable (exercised in platform-09)
Two runs under FixedClock give identical output (shown in the PR)
out_of_scope: Laya or full mode
CI wiring (platform-08)
Running against the partner's real parts (platform-09)

tasks.title: platform: fakes for partner parts and contract test suites
tasks.goal: Let vision, interactions and verdict build without waiting on the partner, and give the partner a ready-made test suite their real code must pass.
acceptance: FakeEntityStore implements EntityStore: ingest() applies ObservationFrames, snapshot() returns entities, start_sync() writes to a given StateClient; never deletes and never changes first_seen_t_ms or origin (test marked safety)

FakeProvenanceGraph implements ProvenanceGraph from a loaded scenario's ground truth (expected allergens_reached, chain_event_ids, late_entities) with no allergen propagation code; reach() returns valid AllergenReach objects (test)
ScriptedClassifier implements InteractionClassifier with scripted labels and an error or hang mode (test)
Every fake can be switched to raise its *Unavailable error, so consumers can test HOLD paths

kitchen/shared/contract_tests has one parametrized suite each for StateClient, EntityStore, ProvenanceGraph and InteractionClassifier, marked `contract`; every fake passes (`uv run pytest kitchen/shared -m contract`)
The ProvenanceGraph suite checks every golden scenario's expected allergens and time-forward chains
kitchen/shared/README.md documents the conftest fixture the partner adds in their own folder to run a suite against real code
out_of_scope: Implementing the real entity store, graph or LSTM (partner)
Editing anything in kitchen/entities, kitchen/graph, kitchen/lstm or database/

tasks.title: platform: generate TypeScript types from contract schemas for web/
tasks.goal: Give the outputs team generated TypeScript types for every contract message, so screens never hand-write contract shapes.
acceptance: `uv run python tools/gen_ts_types.py` (or an npm script it wraps) writes web/src/generated/contracts.ts from every schema in contracts/schemas
`npx tsc --noEmit` type-checks a test file that imports every valid fixture as its generated type
CI job fails if regenerating produces a git diff or tsc fails
The PR is labeled cross-team and carries the outputs Manager's approval for the generated file in web/
The PR records the generator used and any schema feature it could not express
out_of_scope: SpacetimeDB table bindings (generated from the partner's database/ module)
Any screen code in web/

tasks.title: platform: CI job running every golden scenario through the verdict policy
tasks.goal: Every PR that could change a verdict re-checks every golden scenario, so a regression in the safety rules can't merge.
acceptance: `golden-scenarios` CI job runs `uv run pytest tests/e2e -k scenarios` with FakeProvenanceGraph on PRs touching kitchen/verdict/, kitchen/shared/, contracts/ or tests/e2e/
Job summary lists each scenario with pass or fail and, on failure, the first field that differs from `expected`
Nightly scheduled run includes sim-generated scenarios when kitchen/sim has produced them
Proven on the PR: a deliberately wrong expected decision in a scratch copy makes the job fail
out_of_scope: Writing scenarios (sim, or any team via a contracts PR)
The partner's real graph (platform-09)

tasks.title: platform: run contract suites and e2e on the partner's real parts
tasks.goal: When the partner's database client, entity store, graph and LSTM exist, prove they behave exactly like the fakes the agents built against.
acceptance: The contract suites run against the partner's real StateClient (local SpacetimeDB), EntityStore, ProvenanceGraph and LSTM classifier using the fixtures the partner provides in their folders; results posted on the issue
`uv run pytest tests/e2e --state real --graph real` matches the all-fakes run scenario by scenario
A CI job runs these when the partner's code is importable; if SpacetimeDB can't run on CI runners, the PR says so and documents the local-only command
Any behavior difference is filed as a type:request (label owner:partner) or a platform bug, never patched around in the harness
out_of_scope: Changing the partner's implementations or folders
Waiting on the partner: this task stays blocked (needs-partner) until their code lands

tasks.title: platform: CI lane checks for partner paths and PR labels
tasks.goal: CI enforces the lanes: agents can't change partner-owned folders, cross-team PRs are labeled, and contract changes are flagged.
acceptance: A PR touching any partner-owned path in OWNERS fails unless its branch starts with partner/ (builds on tools/check_ownership.py)
A PR touching more than one team's paths fails without the cross-team label; a PR touching contracts/ fails without contract-change; uv.lock regeneration is exempt
The job summary lists the owners each PR touches
Demonstrated on the PR with throwaway commits that trip each check
out_of_scope: Required-review enforcement (approvals are labels, see AGENTS.md §6 How work flows)
Changing OWNERS (Director)

tasks.title: platform: keep .claude/agents definitions in sync with AGENTS.md
tasks.goal: Catch broken or stale agent definitions before they break a launch.
acceptance: tools/check_agents.py parses the YAML frontmatter of every .claude/agents/*.md and fails on missing name or description, duplicate names, or keys outside a documented allowlist
It fails if a definition references a file that doesn't exist or names a team not listed in AGENTS.md
Runs in CI; `python3 tools/check_agents.py` passes on main
out_of_scope: Editing agent prompts or AGENTS.md (Director owns their content)
